plan.title: Live RFQ counter offer remains pending

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ Responses screen with the existing vendor bid.
Ensure RFQ counter offers are available.
Ensure the eRFX project flow required by the case is enabled.
Send a buyer counter offer on the vendor's own bid; the catalog supports one counter price.
Verify the buyer's grid records the counter offer as initiated.
Open the invited vendor's separate supplier-portal session while preserving the buyer session.
Open the live RFQ bid sheet where the vendor can see the pending counter offer.
Verify the vendor portal shows the pending counter offer.
Attempt a vendor revision while the counter offer is pending and require refusal evidence.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Return to the Responses tab for the buyer-side pending state.
Verify the buyer still sees the counter offer as pending after the vendor did not accept or revise.
Open the buyer's Master QCS to inspect the current bid values.
Verify the Master QCS line amounts and total are arithmetically consistent with the current prices.
